name: Multi-Resolution Mesh Adaptation via Graph Cut
definition: A consistent mesh is represented by a graph cut through a DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph). Moving the cut down refines the mesh; moving it up coarsens the mesh.
summary: Multi-Resolution Mesh Adaptation via Graph Cut dynamically balances visual fidelity and cost in volume rendering by maintaining a crack-free, non-overlapping mesh through graph cut consistency on a hierarchical DAG.
